name: Desperate Wish

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia Character Guide

text: You call out a desperate wish to the stars to save a friend. You gain Breath of Life as an innate arcane spell, which you can cast once per day only while in sentinel form. Interceding in such a direct way temporarily exhausts your constellation's magic, causing you to revert from your sentinel form once the spell is cast.
